caption: The drawing, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil on an off-white background, depicts a round plate in two perspectives. At the top, there is a top-down view of the plate, showing a wide, shallow circular depression in the center, bordered by a slightly raised and curved rim. Below this, a side profile of the same plate is shown, revealing its gently sloping sides and modest depth. A horizontal scale marked in inches is situated below the side view for reference. The objects are presented within a lightly outlined rectangular frame, and the artist's name is signed in the bottom right corner inside the frame. The composition is clean and technical, focusing on the form and proportions of the plate.
title: Pewter Deep Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
